name: Idset
note: How screens are put together, from a badge to a window. Every arrangement is one of these patterns, and every value is a token from tokens.json; a screen writes no number of its own. A new arrangement is added here first.
rules: In a fixed-height row everything sits on the center line (cross-axis center).
Content of several lines is top-aligned.
A child's left edge lines up with its parent's padding; glyphs sit in a fixed icon box, never on a text baseline.
A size is one of three: hug the content, fill the parent, or fixed (a size token).
Trailing content goes to the end with a spacer, never with a margin.
Space belongs to the layout (gap and padding); a component has no margin of its own.
Lines under a badge or glyph line up with the name beside it (indent), so a card reads as one column.
The panel is 340 wide and has one column; text gives way (paths ellipsize in the middle, names at the end), never a button by wrapping.

patterns.name: inline
patterns.usage: An icon and text, text and a small tag: inside a button, a status line, a finding.

patterns.name: item-row
patterns.usage: One row, one thing: an identity row, a bind row, a settings row, a form row, a backup row. Trailing items after a spacer.

patterns.name: cluster
patterns.usage: Controls side by side: a dialog's buttons, a card's icon buttons, a problem bar's actions.

patterns.name: control
patterns.usage: The shape of a button. A small button is control-s high with 0 space-2 padding.

patterns.name: stack-tight
patterns.usage: Lines that sit close: a name and its email, a menu's entries.

patterns.name: stack
patterns.usage: Inside a card, the lines of a problem bar, a dialog's body.

patterns.name: stack-block
patterns.usage: The blocks of the panel's content: the drop zone or result card, the filter, the list, the diagnostics summary.

patterns.name: stack-section
patterns.usage: A dialog's sections, an empty state's content.

patterns.name: stack-page
patterns.usage: Between the groups of the editor and of a settings pane.

patterns.name: inset-card
patterns.usage: Cards, problem bars, the panel's content.

patterns.name: inset-dialog
patterns.usage: A dialog window, a menu's frame.

patterns.name: inset-pane
patterns.usage: The accounts detail region, a settings pane, an empty state's region.

patterns.name: indent
patterns.usage: Lines under a leading badge or glyph start where the text beside it does.

patterns.name: center
patterns.usage: Empty states, loading, the about window, the letter in a badge.

patterns.name: bar
patterns.usage: The panel's title row and footer, a window's footer: content, a spacer, buttons at the end.

patterns.name: spacer
patterns.usage: Pushes what follows to the end of a row.

patterns.name: truncate
patterns.usage: Names end in an ellipsis; paths in the middle (code splits start, middle and last folder).

windows.name: panel
windows.usage: The tray panel, fixed size, under the tray icon.

windows.name: accounts
windows.usage: The accounts window: the identity list and the editor.

windows.name: settings
windows.usage: Settings: General, Keys, Import, Backups, Configuration.

windows.name: about
windows.usage: About Idset and the update check.

windows.name: dialog
windows.usage: A modal child window (ADR 0005); its buttons share one width.
